notes.title: v 0.3.1 Update
notes.notes:
Game Adjustments
[list]
[*] Optimized exit UI in the Lightbulb Room
[*] Removed elevator platform levels and replaced with bonsai
[*] Removed early lock-breaking design using cardboard boxes
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed freezing issue when entering far right side of Copper Pipe map
[*] Fixed power outage issue in Ice Copper Pipe level
[/list]

notes.title: v0.3.0 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Game Adjustments
[list]
[*] Reduced explosion damage range during boss battles.
[*] Decreased the number of flying units in boss battles.
[*] Adjusted the movement logic of spikes in Phase 2 of boss battles.
[*] Fixed an issue where shooting mode remained active and unresponsive during story cutscenes.
[*] Changed a texture from an iron door to a wooden door.
[*] Adjusted the orientation of the volume control UI.
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a black screen error when entering the underground entrance a second time in the hotel room.
[*] Fixed an impassable copper pipe in a specific area.
[*] Resolved a freeze when interacting with a copper pipe overlapping spikes and obstacles using the mouse.
[*] Fixed texture issues with boxes and windows.
[*] Fixed the "Investigate E" UI persisting after opening a box.
[*] Fixed a bug where the character spawns inside a wall when returning to the hotel room later in the game.
[*] Addressed abnormal behavior of elevators during battery charging.
[/list]
